subject.title: Conversational agent lane wedges indefinitely: ingress events never reconcile (re-delivery storm on reconnect) + abort_embedded_run leaves owner lock unreleased (released=0)

question: Should the remaining fix for this issue land with the public durable inbound replay API and five-attempt WhatsApp dead-letter policy from the linked PR, or should that API/policy be narrowed before merge?
rationale: The remaining code path is a real bug, but the candidate fix changes plugin SDK surface and message-delivery policy; automation should not decide those compatibility and delivery tradeoffs.

options.title: Accept API and replay cap
options.body: Approve the linked PR's public durable replay helper/types and five-attempt WhatsApp dead-letter behavior, then close this issue after merge and proof.

options.title: Keep replay helper internal
options.body: Ask the PR to preserve the bug fix but remove or narrow public SDK exports, docs, and baseline changes until a second approved consumer exists.

options.title: Split operator tooling
options.body: Land the bounded replay fix separately and open a narrower product issue for inspect, drain, or ack operator commands.

recommendation.title: Accept API and replay cap
recommendation.body: Approve the linked PR's public durable replay helper/types and five-attempt WhatsApp dead-letter behavior, then close this issue after merge and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current candidate PR specifically asks vincentkoc for message-delivery review, and prior ClawSweeper review identified him as the closest channel/message-runtime owner for this policy choice.
